about: Questions written blind from common Electron app-building tasks and merged electron/electron PRs (2026), without seeing the docs; answers labeled separately against the pinned docs.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: Support deep linking so myapp:// links clicked in a web browser open the app
cases.question: How do I register my app as the handler for a custom myapp:// URL scheme and receive the clicked URL on Windows and macOS?
cases.note: Deep Links tutorial: setAsDefaultProtocolClient, second-instance (Win) / open-url (mac), Info.plist packaging; api/app reference entries.

cases.task: Let the renderer UI load the user's settings file through the main process
cases.question: With contextIsolation enabled, how should my preload script expose a function to the page that asks the main process for data and returns it?
cases.note: contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld wrapping ipcRenderer.invoke plus ipcMain.handle; IPC Pattern 2, preload tutorial, context-isolation example.

cases.task: Add a system-wide hotkey that brings the app window to the front
cases.question: How do I register a keyboard shortcut that fires even when my app is in the background and another app has focus?
cases.note: globalShortcut.register works without app focus; keyboard-shortcuts 'Global shortcuts' section and globalShortcut API reference.

cases.task: Replace the native title bar with a custom HTML title bar that matches the app's design
cases.question: How do I hide the native title bar but keep the window draggable and still show the OS minimize, maximize and close buttons?
cases.keywords: custom title bar draggable window controls
cases.note: Basic tutorial: titleBarStyle 'hidden', titleBarOverlay for Win/Linux controls (macOS keeps traffic lights), app-region: drag.

cases.task: Add automatic updates to an open-source app whose installers are published on GitHub Releases
cases.question: What's the easiest way to make my app update itself automatically when new builds are published as GitHub releases?
cases.note: update.electronjs.org via require('update-electron-app')(); requirements and setup in updates guide and tutorial part 6.

cases.task: Fix macOS release builds that Gatekeeper refuses to open after download
cases.question: What steps are needed to code sign and notarize our macOS build so Gatekeeper stops saying the app can't be opened?
cases.note: macOS signing+notarization: Apple Developer requirements, Forge/Packager osxSign + osxNotarize config; packaging tutorial Forge example.

cases.task: Load the bundled frontend from an app:// scheme instead of file:// URLs
cases.question: How can I serve bundled HTML and JS over a custom app:// scheme so fetch and storage behave like a normal web origin?
cases.note: registerSchemesAsPrivileged (standard/secure/supportFetchAPI, storage) plus protocol.handle or registerSource serving bundled app:// files.

cases.task: Move a CPU-heavy image-processing job off the main process so the UI stops freezing
cases.question: How do I run CPU-heavy Node code in a separate process spawned from main and pass messages back and forth with it?
cases.note: utilityProcess.fork, child.postMessage, 'message' event; parentPort doc example shows full two-way messaging.

cases.task: Set breakpoints in main-process code from VS Code
cases.question: How do I attach the VS Code debugger to Electron's main process so breakpoints in my main.js actually get hit?
cases.note: .vscode/launch.json node config launching node_modules/.bin/electron, then breakpoints in main.js hit.

cases.task: Collect native crash reports from users' machines and send them to the team's crash server
cases.question: How do I capture native crash dumps from the main and renderer processes and have them uploaded to our own server?
cases.note: crashReporter.start({submitURL}) early in main monitors renderers; server receives multipart minidump POST.

cases.task: Make the app follow the OS light/dark theme and add a manual theme switch in settings
cases.question: How can the app tell whether the OS is in dark mode, react when it changes, and let the user force light or dark?
cases.note: nativeTheme shouldUseDarkColors, 'updated' event, themeSource; dark-mode overview, plus toggle/reset code under How does this work.

cases.task: Render an HTML overlay without a visible window and feed each frame into a video encoder
cases.question: How can I render a web page without showing any window and get every painted frame as a bitmap image?
cases.note: Offscreen guide: webPreferences.offscreen plus 'paint' event giving NativeImage bitmap; webContents 'paint' event shows same code.

cases.task: Make target=_blank links in the app open in the user's default browser
cases.question: When a page opens a target=_blank link, how do I send it to the default browser instead of a new Electron window?
cases.keywords: open link default browser new window
cases.note: Security #14 How?: setWindowOpenHandler calls shell.openExternal(url) and returns {action:'deny'}.

cases.task: Show spelling suggestions when the user right-clicks a misspelled word in the note editor
cases.question: How do I build a right-click menu that lists spellchecker suggestions and an 'Add to dictionary' item for misspelled words?
cases.note: context-menu event: dictionarySuggestions items with replaceMisspelling, plus 'Add to dictionary' via addWordToSpellCheckerDictionary.

cases.task: Packaged app can't launch its bundled helper binary or open a data file shipped inside app.asar
cases.question: How does Electron handle files inside app.asar at runtime — which Node APIs can read them, and what has to be unpacked?
cases.note: Whole guide: fs/require read archive as virtual dirs, limitations, execFile/dlopen temp extraction, only execFile runs binaries, --unpack.

cases.task: Flush unsaved documents to disk before the app quits
cases.question: In what order do the app's quit-related events fire, and how can I postpone quitting until an async save finishes?
cases.note: app quit events and app.quit() give order before-quit, windows close, will-quit, quit; preventDefault() stops termination.

cases.task: Migrate the main process and preload scripts from CommonJS require to ES module imports
cases.question: Can the main process and preload scripts be written as ES modules instead of CommonJS, and what caveats apply?
cases.note: ESM guide: main via .mjs or type module with await-before-ready caveat; preload needs .mjs, unsandboxed, more caveats.

cases.task: Make the app usable with screen readers such as NVDA and VoiceOver
cases.question: Does Electron expose web page accessibility info to screen readers automatically, or does my app need to enable it somehow?
cases.note: Auto-enabled when assistive tech is detected; can be enabled manually with app.setAccessibilitySupportEnabled or accessibilitySupportEnabled.

cases.task: Keep separate logins for multiple accounts, each in its own window, without sharing cookies
cases.question: How are cookies and storage shared or isolated between windows, and is a window's session data kept on disk across restarts?
cases.keywords: session cookies shared between windows persist
cases.note: Same partition shares a session; persist: prefix stores on disk, otherwise in-memory; the default session is persistent.

cases.task: Show a third-party web dashboard inside one of the app's windows
cases.question: What does Electron recommend locking down before a window loads remote third-party websites, like Node access and sandboxing?
cases.note: Security checklist: no nodeIntegration for remote content, contextIsolation, sandbox, permission handler, isolation for untrusted content.

cases.task: App takes several seconds before its first window appears; speed up startup
cases.question: What are Electron's recommended practices for faster app startup and keeping the main process from blocking the UI?
cases.note: Performance checklist: defer loading/require at startup, avoid blocking main process, lean modules, bundle code, setApplicationMenu(null).

cases.task: Harden the shipped binary so it can't be relaunched as a plain Node.js runtime
cases.question: Which features should be switched off in a production Electron binary so it can't be abused, e.g. ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE or --inspect?
cases.note: Current fuses lists runAsNode, nodeOptions, nodeCliInspect with disable advice; security checklist item 19 covers same via @electron/fuses.

cases.task: Upgrade the app from Electron 33 to the current major release
cases.question: Where can I find what was removed or changed in a breaking way between Electron major versions before upgrading?
cases.note: Breaking Changes doc lists removed/changed/deprecated APIs per major version; other docs only link to it.

cases.task: Store the user's OAuth refresh token on disk without keeping it in plain text
cases.question: Is there a built-in Electron API to encrypt a secret like an auth token with the OS keychain before writing it to disk?
cases.note: safeStorage encryptStringAsync/decryptStringAsync using Keychain/DPAPI/secret-store keys; spread across intro, key providers, methods.

cases.task: Make API calls from the main process that respect the user's system proxy settings
cases.question: Which API should the main process use for HTTP requests so they go through Chromium's networking and honor system proxy settings?
cases.note: net module intro: Chromium networking with automatic system proxy config (PAC/WPAD); use net.request/net.fetch. ses.fetch lacks proxy info.

cases.task: Window flashes white for a moment before the dark-themed UI renders
cases.question: My window flashes white for a moment before the page renders, even though the app uses a dark theme; how do I avoid that?
cases.note: Create window with show:false and show on ready-to-show, or set backgroundColor near the app's background.

cases.task: App crashes on launch after adding the better-sqlite3 native dependency
cases.question: Loading a native module fails with 'compiled against a different Node.js version using NODE_MODULE_VERSION'; how do I fix it for Electron?
cases.note: Rebuild for Electron: @electron/rebuild, npm_config_* env vars, or node-gyp with Electron headers; intro quotes the error.

cases.task: Desktop notifications work on macOS but never appear on Windows
cases.question: Notifications appear fine on macOS but nothing shows on Windows while running the app in development; what does Windows require?
cases.note: Windows needs Start Menu shortcut with AppUserModelID; in development pin electron.exe and call app.setAppUserModelId.

cases.task: After upgrading Electron, the preload script can no longer require an npm package
cases.question: After an Electron upgrade, my preload script fails with 'Unable to load preload script' when requiring an npm module; why and how to fix?
cases.keywords: unable to load preload script require
cases.note: Preloads sandboxed by default since Electron 20; require only loads electron; bundle the preload or set sandbox:false.

cases.task: Tray icon vanishes a minute or so after the app starts
cases.question: The tray icon appears at launch but disappears after a minute or two with no errors logged; what causes that?
cases.note: Tray object gets garbage collected; keep the Tray referenced in a global variable.

cases.task: docs: fix incorrect heading levels
cases.question: What heading levels does the Electron docs style guide expect for page titles, sections, and individual API methods and events?
cases.note: Single # title, ## chapters; API ## Methods/Events/Class chapters; methods/events ### (module) or #### (class).

cases.task: chore!: remove deprecated console-message event arguments
cases.question: Which commit message types does Electron use, and how should a commit that removes a deprecated API be marked as breaking?
cases.note: Prefix list (fix, feat, docs, ...) and BREAKING CHANGE: at body/footer start; versioning doc repeats feat/fix and BREAKING CHANGE.

cases.question: What's the process for backporting fixes that already landed on main to the currently supported release branches?
cases.note: Backport PRs to supported lines, Releases WG resolves disputes; fixes cherry-picked from main into $MAJOR-x-y branches.

cases.task: feat: add Menu.setHighlightColors() for Windows
cases.question: I'm adding a new Windows-only method to an existing main-process API module; which files need changes, from C++ bindings to typings and docs?
cases.note: New-module checklist: C++ SetMethod binding, docs .md generates electron.d.ts, lib_sources_win in filenames.gni.

cases.task: fix: cherry-pick 431b8be6a111 from chromium
cases.question: How do I add an upstream Chromium commit as a new patch in Electron's patches directory and regenerate the patch files?
cases.note: Commit the change in the upstream checkout, then run script/git-export-patches -o patches/<project>; subject names the patch.

cases.task: fix: improve asar archive path handling
cases.question: How do I run only the asar-related spec files from Electron's test suite instead of the whole thing?
cases.note: npm run test -- --files spec/<file> or -g PATTERN; pull-requests shows yarn test -match=<name> for matching spec modules.

cases.task: docs: explain ChromeDriver arguments during testing
cases.question: How do I configure ChromeDriver with Selenium to launch an Electron app binary and pass extra command-line arguments to it?
cases.note: Run electron-chromedriver; selenium-webdriver goog:chromeOptions binary; extra args not shown for Selenium (only WDIO appArgs).

cases.task: docs: `?` in preload script globs matches zero or one character
cases.question: How are URL filter patterns for session-registered preload scripts matched against frame URLs, and which glob wildcards are supported?
cases.note: Session lists match conditions and which frame URL is used; structs: * any sequence, ? zero-or-one (PreloadScript says single char).

cases.task: feat: support chrome.storage.sync in extensions
cases.question: Where does Electron document which chrome.* extension APIs are supported, so I can add chrome.storage.sync to that list?
cases.note: api/extensions.md 'Supported Extensions APIs' lists chrome.* APIs; the chrome.storage subsection is where storage.sync goes.

cases.task: chore: bump chromium to 159.0.8130.0 (main)
cases.question: After the Chromium roll, gclient sync stops with 'Conflict while rebasing this branch'; how do I get my checkout syncing again?
cases.note: Run git am --abort in src then e sync -f, or git checkout --detach HEAD in the repo with a checked-out branch.
